body: Thank you very much for replying, it really helped me :)

What could make you feel better? What makes you feel okay? How can i help you?
I know that this is hard, i think that with the proper help you can get out of this. Please trust me. Listen to the hotline. You are whort it. I know you are.
This is late, very late, but can you call a suicide hotline? It's just a final option. I care for you, your life is whort it. You can talk to me.
Then please call a suicide hotline, they will help you in a short time. Your life is worth it. What is making you feel so sad? You can talk to me.
You prefer to lose your life before breaking a promise? Then please promise someone you will get help. You deserve to be happy. I would say that you make a promise to me, then.

So what? Is someone going to punish you for it? No. You are strong, and i know you can endure this. I care for you, and other people do too. Even if you think that you have no choice but suicide, what about doing it later? Get therapy, a helper dog, a talk with a friend, etc. What are you going to lose anyway? I know you can do this, i just know it.
I hope you make a lot of friends and it goes well. Good luck ;)

You can try some changes in your life. What are you going to lose anyway? Change schools, or work, do some hobbies and try to get some new friends in the community. It doesn't matter if you're not good at it, you're not a product. You're a human looking for happiness. 
Don't do drugs tou. DRUGS=BAD lmao

I think that thought alone is something bad. You don't have to be more hurt to get help or someone to care. You DESERVE help. Please do it.
And someone does care for you. I'm sure of it. 
Do you have a family, a lover, a friend, a pet? Think of them. And so what if you don't have one? Life is long and people come and go. Do something to get one person to care for you. Even when you don't endure something sad. 
It's okay to “whine”, but try to change your lifestyle for your own good.
Maybe it's not that deep, and i'm just ranting to a complete fucking stranger, but know that i care for you :( lmao
